title: Kenya Building Footprints and Field Boundaries Dataset
description: High-resolution drone satellite imagery of the Kenol section of Murang'a, Kenya, with pixel-level labels for building footprint and field boundary segmentation. Images are 512×512 RGBA tiles in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF format. Labels encode building footprints (class 1), field boundaries (class 2), overlapping areas (class 3), and background (class 0).

## README.md
## About the Dataset
This dataset provides high-resolution satellite imagery collected via drones in the Kenol section of Murang'a, Kenya. The dataset includes both raw drone imagery and labeled imagery intended for building footprint and field boundary segmentation tasks.

- **Provided by**: [@ksa](https://beta.source.coop/ksa/)
- **Author**: Kenya Space Agency

## Data Format

The dataset is structured in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF format, which enables efficient access to large geospatial datasets over the web.

## Usage

The dataset is suitable for training and evaluating models for field boundary and building footprint segmentation tasks. The labels are provided in the `Labels` directory, with building footprints labeled with a class value of 1, and field boundaries labeled with a class value of 2.
In the case where building footprint is within field boundary, it has a class value of 3.
Every other item not either of the two has a class value of 0.

## Image Details

- **Image Dimensions**: 512 x 512 pixels
- **Image Channels**: RGBA

## Download Dataset
This dataset can be dowloaded via the `ACCESS DATA` tab. Labels can be found within the `labels` sub-directory and `imagery` can be found within the imagery sub-directory
